subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw status loads memory plugins locally and can report false vector state

question: Should memory-reporting status use live gateway memory-runtime truth, a passive local plugin status contract, or stop reporting plugin vector state from the CLI process?
rationale: Current main only mitigates fast status; resolving the remaining full-status behavior changes the user-visible status contract and plugin API expectations.

options.title: Use live gateway truth
options.body: Status memory details should prefer the running gateway's memory runtime health and avoid local plugin startup for plugin-owned memory state.

options.title: Define passive local status
options.body: Keep local status reporting but require a narrow plugin status API that cannot run embedder, backfill, or vector startup work.

options.title: Do not report plugin vector state
options.body: Treat plugin memory vector readiness as unavailable to CLI status and direct users to plugin-owned diagnostics instead.

recommendation.title: Use live gateway truth
recommendation.body: Status memory details should prefer the running gateway's memory runtime health and avoid local plugin startup for plugin-owned memory state.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent PR metadata put the present status and memory-runtime surfaces under Vincent Koc's recent work.
